system.description:
Minotaur-headed lord of beasts and the endless maze. More dangerous when cornered.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Advantage on all Strength checks and Fortitude saves. When below half HP, your damaging cantrips and spells increase by one damage die.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Passive: you cannot become lost by any means, magical or mundane. You always know the layout of any structure you have entered and can retrace any path you have walked.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, enter Bestial Fury for 1 minute — +4 AC, Advantage on your first melee attack roll each round, immunity to charm and fear. Spellcasting impossible while active.
